summary: A very thin week — 10 messages total, almost all of it chasing one payment. Callie's re-sent Jul 15-31 wire (stopped by her bank's fraud flag) went missing for three days; Stephski confirmed on Aug 9 it had not landed, and on Aug 11 said 'I believe we got it... Will update you shortly!' — but no final confirmation was ever sent, and Callie's direct question about whether the payment came through twice has now gone unanswered since Aug 8. Separately, Derrek's Aug 1 promise of 'plenty of updates starting next week' on the phone-farm / IG posting rollout produced nothing for a second straight week; Derrek and Vivek were both silent in the chat. The only proactive team output all week was Mica's weekly reel-inspo drop on Aug 13. Callie stayed warm and raised no explicit complaint, but she is receiving very little for a client with a paused IG posting programme.
